name: Seven Demon Kings of the Wilds

pages.title: Territories of the Seven Kings
pages.text: This entry follows patchouli_static_entries.json#barbarian_seven_kings, barbarian_demon_kings.json, and secret_realm_template.json#barbarian_king_territories. All seven territories are now listed as explorable secret realms in the world data.

pages.title: Available Territories
pages.text: The seven available territories are king_bear_mountain, king_fox_mist, king_pine_ancient, king_roc_sky, king_snake_swamp, king_tiger_jungle, and king_turtle_depth. All belong to barbarian_wasteland, require the Void Refinement realm, consume immortal_jade as admission, and have a 600000-tick reentry cooldown.

pages.title: Territory Traits
pages.text: The current world data defines entrances, requirements, and traits: the Bear King favors strength_earth, the Fox King illusion_wind, the Ancient Pine wood_array, the Roc King wind_flight, the Snake King poison_water, the Tiger King melee_hunt, and the Black Tortoise defense_array.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Unique drops, Demon King tokens, the three-token audience with the Wilds Council, tribute trade, territory quests, actual bosses, GeckoLib animations, and structure generation are not yet implemented. The corresponding native routes are projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Spirit Realm: Tianyuan and the Fengyuan Clans'; native progress remains authoritative. This page describes only the existing data hooks.
